But did you know that it wasn’t made for popping in the beginning? This brings us to its funny story! Let’s learn more about it! In 1957, two engineers tried to invent a new kind of wallpaper. They put two shower curtains together with air bubbles between them. The result? A bumpy (不平整的), bubbly mess! Instead of cool wallpaper, they made something much more exciting. However, bubble wrap didn’t work as wallpaper at first. In fact, it wasn’t used for anything because it wasn’t flat! But when people saw it protected fragile things well, they sold it as packing material. Soon, people used bubble wrap to protect glass and electronics during shipping. But it wasn’t popular until people fell in love with its fun “pop”. They started popping it for enjoyment, making it a playful activity. Many say popping bubble wrap helps them relax by popping their worries away! People use bubble wrap for packing, making art projects, and as a fun toy. Some companies make bubble wrap so that you can pop it again and again, so the fun keeps going! The next time you open a package and hear the fun pops, think about bubble wrap’s journey-from a failed wallpaper idea to a perfect stress—relieving toy. This change shows that sometimes good inventions come from happy accidents and a bit of imagination! 1. Why did the two engineers invent bubble wrap in the first place? A. questions.stem: If someone makes fun of your sister and you want to tell her not to pay too much attention to it, youcan say, “_________”.
questions.expl: 本文主要介绍了应怎样面对别人的嘲笑。

questions.stem: ________ is at the top of the food chain in the sea.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“you can follow the ‘20-20-20’ rule—after 20 minutes’ use of eyes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds”可知，第一个“20”指的是“用眼时长”。故选A。

questions.stem: People’s inventions can be sometimes dangerous because ________.
opts: they can kill a lot of wild wolves
they can destroy the food chain
they can make wild rabbits grow bigger and bigger
questions.expl: 理解题。根据短文第二段举的例子可知，人们用枪杀死了很多野狼。近年来，因为野狼的 数量越来越少，野兔的数量增多，由于野兔的严重破坏，许多草原变成了沙漠。由此可知人们破坏 了生物链。故选B。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “threat” refer to?
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据语境“For example, many years ago in Inner Mongolia, people used guns to kill a lot of wild wolves. People thought they posed a threat to their sheep.”可知，人们用枪杀死野狼，因为人们 觉得狼对羊来说是一个威胁。threat“威胁”。故选B。

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of this passage?
opts: To tell people who is at the top of the food chain.
To discuss why human beings invented cars and guns.
To show the importance of wild wolves.
To make us pay more attention to what we do to the animals.
questions.expl: 本文介绍了狮子是陆地食物链的顶端，鲨鱼是海洋食物链的顶端，而整个世界食物链的顶 端是人类。人类是食物链的一部分，我们要注意保护动物，才能维持生态平衡。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is a good posture?
opts: Standing with the weight on one leg.
Crossing legs for a long time.
Looking down at a phone with a bent neck for hours.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一段“Wukong, Tiangong, Tianwen… Do you know where these names of Chinese space programs come from?”可知，文章是以问问题来开篇的。故选C。

questions.stem: What posture can help us get to know he is confident?
opts: Walking with arms close to the body.
Stepping a bit faster, with head up.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据原文“So walk a little faster, keep your head up, and look straight ahead”可知，走 快一点，抬头，直视前方，由这些动作可以知道此人是一个自信的人。故选C。

questions.stem: To overcome shyness, what ought we to do?
opts: Practice more to form a good posture.
Do more sports in our spare time.
Try anything that can make ourselves feel good.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据原文“1. Have a good posture (姿势) | 2. Increase your walking speed | 3. Do some exercise | 4. Do things that make you feel good about yourself”可知，作者给出了四条克服害羞的建议， 即①保持良好的姿势；②增加步行速度；③做一些运动；④做一些让你自我感觉良好的事情。故选 D。 4. 推理判断题。根据原文“Shyness is a kind of fear. People who are shy always worry too much about what people think of them or embarrassing (使尴尬) themselves in some way in front of others”可知，害 羞是一种恐惧。害羞的人总是太担心别人对他们的看法，或者在别人面前让自己尴尬。C 选项“当 她在课堂上被要求回答问题时，她会感到紧张”符合语境，故选C。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what’s a shy girl like?
opts: She likes making eye contact with others while talking.
She is not afraid to try new things.
She will feel nervous when she is asked to answer questions in class.
She is good at expressing her opinions in public.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Human children need around 10 hours of sleep a night (you’d need two hours if you were a giraffe and twenty-two hours if you were a koala).”可知一个小孩每晚需要睡十个小时。故 选B。 5. 推理判断题。本文主要介绍了数字的有趣事实，因此可能在数学博客上读到此文章。故选C。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of this passage?
opts: To show us what shyness is.
To tell us increasing your walking speed is the best way to overcome shyness.
To teach us what can help us to have a good posture.
To give us some tips to overcome shyness.
questions.expl: 本文是一篇说明文，作者给出了四条克服害羞的建议。

questions.stem: What does the first “20” in the “20-20-20” rule in Paragraph 2 mean?
opts: How long you use your eyes.
How often you take a break.
How far you look at things from you.
How many things you need to do at the break.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一段中的“Take a close look at the world of insects, and you’ll find many unbelievable things. Think about butterflies, for example.”可知，A 项提及；根据第一段中的“They have beautiful colourful wingsand strong fantastic flying skills.”可知，B 项和C 项提及。故选D。

questions.stem: How many health problems are mentioned in the passage?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“First, looking at the screen of your smartphone or computer for too long can make your eyes dry.”，第三段“Next, other parts of our body could also become worse because of using smartphones.”，第四段“In addition, smartphones could hurt our brain.”以及第五段“Finally, another serious danger is Internet addiction (瘾).”可知，文中提到了4 种健康问题。故选C。

questions.stem: To keep off Internet addiction, what does the writer advise us to do?
opts: Control the time of using the Internet.
Use the Internet in a safe place.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第五段“One way to work out this problem is to control the time they spend on the Internet.”可知，为了防止网瘾，作者建议我们控制上网的时间。故选B。

questions.stem: What is the structure of the passage?
questions.expl: 本文讲述了过度使用智能手机和电脑可能会引起的健康问题以及相应的建议。 【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之说明文(17 篇)(

questions.stem: What do the satellite Wukong and the Monkey King have in common (相似)?
opts: They both help with scientific studies.
They both help the good and punish the bad.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段中的“The Wukong satellite is just as sharp-eyed as the Monkey King, helping scientists search for dark matter in space.”可知，卫星悟空和孙悟空的共同之处在于两者都有 着锐利的眼睛。故选A。

questions.stem: What is Tiangong used for?
opts: It’s used for searching dark matter.
It’s used to explore (探索) Mars.
It’s used to send astronauts to space.
It’s used as a home for the astronauts in space.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The Mayans were also the first to create symbols of nothing (or zero).”可知，零 的符号最早出现在玛雅数字系统。故选D。

questions.stem: Why do we take the naming of Chinese space programs seriously?
opts: We want to land on Mars.
We want to protect the Earth.
We have the hunger for truth.
We have a dream for space.
questions.expl: 本文是一篇说明文。文章主要介绍了太空项目命名的由来。

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned in Paragraph 1?
opts: Butterflies are a kind of insect.
Butterflies have a good sense of smell.

questions.stem: What is the right order of the development of a butterfly?①It becomes a pupa.②It becomes a walking insect.③Female butterflies lay an egg.④It spreads wings and flies away.
What’s the structure of this passage? (①=Paragraph 1 ②=Paragraph 2,…)
questions.expl: 结构题。通读全文可知，①为总起，举例说明大自然中的昆虫世界很神奇，引出下文； ②③④⑤介绍了蝴蝶从卵变成蝴蝶的过程；⑥为总结，介绍了自然世界中还有很多神奇的东西。故 选A。 4. 主旨大意题。根据最后一段中的“After a few weeks, this adult butterfly lays her eggs, and the cycle begins all over again.”并通读全文可知，本文主要讲述蝴蝶生命中的几个阶段。故选B。

questions.stem: What does this passage mainly talk about?
opts: The life cycle of a butterfly is amazing.
A butterfly has a short life.
A butterfly is a beautiful insect.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Then, the boy gets lots of offers to make advertisements for teddy bears and makes a lot of money. Now, you can say the boy has the last laugh. When you have the last laugh, you end up winning.”可知，男孩笑到了最后，去打广告赚了钱，因此当一个人笑到最后，他最终会获得成功。 故选A。

questions.stem: Where can you probably find this text?
questions.expl: 本文主要讲述蝴蝶生命中的几个阶段。
